The customer is paying for the principals, not the agency machine.

Creative.tagline: A marketing agency for the brands that hate ads.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Skip Ad is the universal user action on online advertising — naming the agency after the user's preferred response signals the brand's argument about marketing fatigue. Stands in the lineage of declarative creative naming.
Creative.manifesto: Most marketing agencies promise transformation, growth, virality. We made Maybe Later because the truth about marketing is that most of it is ignored. 'Maybe later' is the single most common response to any marketing message. We are the agency that knows it, names it, and builds campaigns the customer doesn't say it to.
Creative.industrySummary: Marketing branding has been polished and slightly desperate. There's room for a small agency that's honest about the difficulty of the work, sharp enough to make jokes about it, and serious enough to ship campaigns that survive contact with a real audience.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Mother (motherlondon.com) holds the irreverent agency peer position. Wieden+Kennedy (wk.com) sits at the institutional tier. Friends of The Family (friendsofthefamily.co) holds the small-personality middle. We sit sharper than any of them.
Creative.positioningStatement: A small marketing studio for clients who know how often customers say 'maybe later'.
